prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame, charcoal #101412 ground with carbon-grain texture, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 for Arsenal FC, slate #8ca6bf for Leeds United FC; the lower quarter is permanently reserved for yellow subtitles. Two named variants share one grid: editorial and statistical. Editorial variant: an illustrative football pitch sketched in thin warm-white lines fills the upper two thirds, ball paths arc from each touchline, lime for Arsenal FC and slate for Leeds United FC, converging on one crest as the single focal point; kinetic Spanish typography stacks GOLES and A FAVOR one word per beat with rhythmic spring pops; no axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Statistical variant: paired bars for both teams on a shared zero baseline, unit goles, four bars: Arsenal FC goles a favor {{home.gf}}, Arsenal FC goles recibidos {{home.ga}}, Leeds United FC goles a favor {{away.gf}}, Leeds United FC goles recibidos {{away.ga}}, all labelled in Spanish with axis unit goles and one common scale resolved by the renderer. Sample treatment: 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos local, {{away.n}} partidos visitante'; source line: 'Fuente: fixtures Bzzoiro, provider Bzzoiro' pinned small in slate under the chart, sample sizes stay attached to every value. Stages across eight seconds: entry 0.0-1.4 wipe of pitch lines and heading; build 1.4-3.2 bars grow with countUp and stagger; main 3.2-6.4 the paired comparison locks and the gap between a favor and recibidos is emphasised; exit 6.4-8.0 bars collapse into the crest. Transitions: stripe sweep in, dissolve from editorial to statistical, shutter out. Camera push-in 1.0 to 0.9 with drift, tilt 1 degree. Emphasis words GOLES, DIFERENCIA, MUESTRA. Legible Spanish hierarchy, one focal point, subtitle band untouched.
